notes.title: FIRST BUG FIX UPDATE
notes.notes:
🚧 Patch Notes – Bug Fix Update
This update aims to fix many bugs and improve the overall experience based on feedback received from players. Below you can find the details of the changes and fixes made:

🔧 Fixed Bugs and Changes:

 Fixed a bug where the parking lot upgrade would not apply unless the game was restarted.
 The entrance gate of the parking lot has been slightly widened.
 Fixed an issue in the "Upgrades" tab of the parking lot computer.
 Reduced the entry area on the right side of all cars to prevent entering the wrong vehicle when cars are parked side by side.
 Fixed the issue where the language could not be selected in the Settings panel of the City and Nightclub sections.
 Removed unused and unnecessary rooms in the Nightclub section.
 Music in the Casino area of the Nightclub has been completely removed.
 Fixed the issue where music would suddenly increase in volume while playing Blackjack in the Casino.
 Fixed a bug where players could get stuck inside the drink bar in the Casino area.
 Fixed a bug where taking and repaying a loan prevented taking another loan.
 Reduced the volume of money earning and spending sound effects.
 Fixed the inability to go back using the Backspace key in the category menus of the Car Mechanic UI.
 Fixed a bug where leaving the city's boundaries would prevent players from returning.
 Many other small bugs have been fixed.


(New bugs may have been added in the process 😅)

⚠️ Known and Ongoing Issues:

 Cars randomly stop working.

 Temporary workaround:
 If it's a customer vehicle in the parking lot, it will automatically despawn after some time.
 If it's one of your own cars, going back to the main menu or to the nightclub and then returning to the city should fix it.

 Sometimes when traveling from the Nightclub to the city, the player is teleported to their home.


We aim to resolve these issues in future updates. Thank you for your feedback! 🚗💨
